properties.name: What flo2 said must not regress, 2026-09-19: the refusals that teach the model, and prose_currency
properties.statement: Recorded as evidence a regression check can read later. ① `create_edge`'s invalid-pair refusal — it names why the pair is illegal, then every edge type that WOULD accept it, each with its hint, distinguishing exact matches from wildcard ones. The reporter: it 'taught me the model' and they dropped an edge they were about to force. ② `set_epoch_status`'s `prose_currency` block — it quoted the description back and pointed out the prose was written under the old status: 'the best safety response I have seen from this surface.' ③ `add_decision` refusing an unapproved `accepted`. ④ The revision-safety note firing on all four revise calls, not just the first: 'consistency matters more than cleverness for a safety net.'
